question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Abridge
solution:
Here the correct answer is **Shorten.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct synonym of the word **"Abridge"** is** 4) Shorten**.
 
• **Abridge** means **to reduce or shorten a piece of text or a speech while retaining the essential content.**
 
 
• Example: "The editor **abridged **the novel to make it more accessible to a wider audience."
 
 
 
• The meaning of **"shorten" **is** to make something shorter in length or duration.**
 
 
• Example sentence: "I had to **shorten **my vacation by two days due to work obligations."
 
 
 
• In summary, the most appropriate synonym for "Abridge" is "Shorten."
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1) Combine **- This word does not have the same meaning as "Abridge." Combine means to join two or more things together to form a single entity.

 
 
• Example: "She **combined **the flour, sugar, and eggs to make the cake batter."
 
 
 
• **Option 2) Divide **- This word does not have the same meaning as "Abridge." Divide means to separate into parts or groups.
 
 
• Example: "The class was **divided **into smaller groups for the project."
 
 
 
• **Option 3) Align **- This word does not have the same meaning as "Abridge." Align means to bring into line or agreement with a particular group or cause.
 
 
• Example: "The company's values **align **with my own personal beliefs."
